name: School
definition: A California public school record uniquely identified by CDSCode, carrying location, governance, status and contact attributes.
scope: california_schools domain of the merged database

name: School District
definition: A school district or county office of education that operates schools; identified by District name and classified by district type code.

name: County
definition: California county in which a school or district is located.

name: Charter School Status
definition: Whether a school is a charter school (1) or not (0). Null appears for records without a charter determination.

name: Virtual School Status
definition: Instructional delivery code for a school: F (exclusively virtual), P (partial virtual), N (not virtual).

name: School Ownership Code
definition: SOC code classifying school type/ownership, paired with SOCType text (for example 66 = High Schools (Public)).

name: District Type Code
definition: DOC numeric code classifying the district or governing body, paired with DOCType text (for example 52 = Elementary School District, 54 = Unified School District).

name: School Funding Type
definition: Charter funding classification of a school: Directly funded, Locally funded, Not in CS funding model, or null.

name: Enrollment K-12
definition: Number of students enrolled in grades K-12 (grades 1 through 12 in this domain) at a school.

name: Free Meal Count K-12
definition: Count of K-12 students eligible for free meals at a school.

name: Eligible Free Meal Rate K-12
definition: Percentage of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals; stored as a ratio multiplied by 100 in the percent column.

name: FRPM Count K-12
definition: Count of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals at a school.

name: Eligible FRPM Rate K-12
definition: Percentage of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
aliases: free or reduced price meal rate

name: Enrollment Ages 5-17
definition: Number of students aged 5-17 enrolled at a school, used as a comparison population to K-12 enrollment.

name: SAT Average Reading Score
definition: Average SAT reading score for a school or district, stored in satscores.AvgScrRead.
scope: california_schools domain, satscores rows with non-null scores

name: SAT Average Math Score
definition: Average SAT math score for a school or district.

name: SAT Average Writing Score
definition: Average SAT writing score for a school or district.

name: School Street Address
definition: Physical street address and mailing/postal street address of a school.

name: School Telephone Number
definition: Contact telephone number of a school.

name: School Open and Closed Dates
definition: Dates on which a school opened and closed, used for temporal filtering of schools.

name: Magic Card
definition: A Magic: The Gathering card printing, identified by cards.id and the card uuid used to link rulings, legalities and foreign translations.

name: Card Set
definition: A Magic card set identified by set code and set name in the sets table.

name: Card Artist
definition: Name of the artist who illustrated a card.

name: Card Border Color
definition: Border color style of a card printing, such as black, white, gold, silver or borderless.

name: Card Power
definition: Power value of a creature card; the literal '*' denotes infinite power and NULL denotes no power value.

name: Card Legal Format
definition: Play format for which a card legality status is recorded, such as commander, vintage, legacy or modern.

name: Card Legality Status
definition: Legality of a card in a format: Legal, Banned or Restricted.

name: Card Ruling
definition: An official rules clarification attached to a card, linked by card uuid.

name: Foreign Card Translation
definition: A foreign-language printing record for a card, carrying language, translated name and translated text, linked by card uuid.

name: Set Name Translation
definition: The translated name of a card set in a given language, linked to sets by set code; translation text may be null.

name: Card Foil Availability
definition: Marketplace identifiers indicating whether a card is available as a foil (cardKingdomFoilId) and as a non-foil printing (cardKingdomId).

name: Story Spotlight Flag
definition: Whether a card is a Story Spotlight card (isStorySpotlight = 1).

name: Textless Card Flag
definition: Whether a card has no text box (isTextless = 1).
aliases: do not have a text box

name: Set Base Size
definition: Base set size of a set, i.e. the number of cards in the set before variant printings.

name: Card Frame Version
definition: Frame style/version of a card printing (for example 1997, 2003).

name: Foreign Language
definition: Language of a foreign card or set translation, such as Chinese Simplified, German, Italian or Japanese.

name: Debit Card Customer
definition: A customer of the debit card program identified by CustomerID, with market segment and payment currency.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Market segment of a customer: SME (small and medium enterprise), LAM (large account management) or KAM (key account management).

name: Customer Currency
definition: Currency in which a customer pays: CZK (Czech koruna) or EUR (euro).

name: Gas Station
definition: A fuel retail station identified by GasStationID, with chain, country and segment.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: Country code of a gas station: CZE for Czech Republic, SVK for Slovakia.

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: Market segment of a gas station: Discount, Premium, Noname, Other or Value for money.

name: Debit Card Transaction
definition: A fuel purchase transaction identified by TransactionID, with date, time, customer, card, station, product, amount and price.

name: Fuel Product
definition: A fuel or service product sold at gas stations, with a Czech-language product description.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: Total monthly fuel consumption of a customer, stored per CustomerID and YYYYMM month in yearmonth.

name: Transaction Date
definition: Calendar date of a transaction in ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

name: Transaction Time
definition: Time of day of a transaction in HH:MM:SS form.

name: Bank Client
definition: A bank client identified by client_id, with gender, birth date and home district.

name: Bank Account
definition: A bank account identified by account_id, opened on a date at a district branch with a statement frequency.

name: Account Disposition
definition: Linkage between a client and an account, with disposition type OWNER or DISPONENT.

name: Loan Contract
definition: A loan contract identified by loan_id, linked to an account, with amount, duration, payment and status.

name: Loan Contract Status
definition: Status code of a loan contract: A and B are finished contracts, C is a running contract in good standing, D is a running contract with the client in debt.

name: Account Transaction
definition: A debit/credit movement on an account, identified by trans_id, with date, type, operation, amount and balance.

name: Transaction Type
definition: Czech-coded direction of a transaction: PRIJEM (credit), VYDAJ (debit/expense) or VYBER (withdrawal).

name: Transaction Operation
definition: Czech-coded operation mode of a transaction, such as VYBER KARTOU (credit card withdrawal), VKLAD (deposit) or PREVOD NA UCET (transfer to account).

name: Bank District/Branch
definition: A district (branch region) identified by district_id, carrying demographic and economic statistics in columns A2-A16.

name: District Unemployment Rate
definition: District unemployment rate percentage in 1995 (A12) and 1996 (A13).

name: District Crime Count
definition: Average number of crimes committed in the district in 1995 (A15) and 1996 (A16).

name: District Population
definition: Number of inhabitants of a district (A4).

name: District Average Salary
definition: Average salary in a district (A11).

name: Payment Card
definition: A payment card issued to a disposition, identified by card_id, with type and issue date.

name: Payment Card Type
definition: Card tier: classic, gold (high-level card) or junior.

name: Client Age
definition: Age of a client derived from birth_date; no age column is stored.

name: Client Gender
definition: Gender of a client: F (female) or M (male).

name: Formula 1 Driver
definition: A Formula 1 driver identified by driverId, with reference name, forename, surname, date of birth, nationality and URL.

name: Formula 1 Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 constructor/team identified by constructorId, with name, nationality and URL.

name: Formula 1 Race
definition: A Formula 1 Grand Prix event identified by raceId, with year, round, name, circuit and date.

name: Formula 1 Circuit
definition: A racing circuit identified by circuitId, with name, location, country, latitude, longitude, altitude and URL.

name: Race Result
definition: A driver's result in a race, identified by resultId, with grid, finishing position, points, laps, finish time, fastest lap and status.

name: Race Status
definition: Final status of a driver's race entry, such as Finished, Accident, Disqualified or a mechanical failure.

name: Finish Time
definition: Race finish time. The winner carries an absolute HH:MM:SS.mmm value; other classified drivers carry a relative '+seconds' offset; NULL means the driver did not finish.

name: Finishing Position
definition: Final race position of a driver; position 1 is the champion/winner.

name: Championship Points
definition: Points awarded to a driver or constructor in a race or standings entry.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: A driver's qualifying result in a race, with first, second and third qualifying period times q1, q2 and q3.

name: Pit Stop
definition: A pit stop by a driver in a race, with stop number, lap, clock time and duration.

name: Lap Time
definition: A single lap time by a driver in a race, with lap number, position, time and milliseconds.

name: Constructor Race Result
definition: Points earned by a constructor in a race, used for per-race constructor standings comparisons.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: Driver name composed from forename and surname; questions name drivers by full name.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: Nationality of a driver or constructor.

name: Fastest Lap Speed
definition: Fastest lap speed recorded in a race result, stored as text in km/h.

name: Race Season Year
definition: Season year of a race, stored on the race record and used for chronological filtering.

name: Student Club Member
definition: A student club member identified by member_id, with name, contact details, position, t-shirt size, zip code and major.

name: Club Event
definition: A student club event identified by event_id, with name, date, type, location and status.

name: Event Status
definition: Lifecycle status of an event: Open, Closed or Planning.

name: Event Attendance
definition: Link record stating that a member attended an event; one row per member-event pair.

name: Event Budget
definition: A budget line for an event category, with allocated amount, spent amount and remaining amount.

name: Club Expense
definition: An expense incurred by a member for an event budget, with description, date, cost and approval flag.

name: Expense Approval
definition: Whether an expense is approved, stored as the text value 'true' (with a null for one record).

name: Academic Major
definition: A university major identified by major_id, with major name, department and college.

name: ZIP Code Geography
definition: US ZIP code reference record with city, county, state and short state, used for geographic grouping.

name: Member Full Name
definition: Member full name composed from first_name and last_name.

name: Budget Category
definition: Expense category of a budget line, such as Advertisement, Food or Speaker Gifts.

name: Member Position
definition: Club role of a member, such as President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer, Member or Inactive.

name: Superhero
definition: A superhero or villain identified by id, with name, full name, gender, colour, race, publisher, alignment, height and weight.

name: Comic Publisher
definition: A comic publisher identified by id and publisher_name.

name: Hero Attribute Type
definition: One of six rated attributes: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat.

name: Hero Attribute Value
definition: Numeric rating of a superhero for one attribute, stored in hero_attribute.attribute_value.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superpower in the superpower reference table, linked to heroes through hero_power.

name: Hero Gender
definition: Gender of a superhero: id 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = N/A.

name: Hero Alignment
definition: Moral alignment of a character: Good, Bad (villain), Neutral or N/A.

name: Colour
definition: Colour reference used for eye, hair and skin colour of a superhero, including the literal value 'No Colour'.

name: Hero Race
definition: Species/race of a superhero, such as Alien, Human, Amazon or Android.

name: Hero Full Name
definition: Civilian full name of a superhero, stored separately from the superhero name.

name: Hero Height and Weight
definition: Height in centimetres (height_cm) and weight in kilograms (weight_kg) of a superhero.

name: Thrombosis Patient
definition: A patient identified by ID, with sex, birthday, description date, first visit date, admission type and diagnosis.

name: Medical Examination
definition: A patient examination event with examination date, antibody measurements, diagnosis, symptoms and thrombosis severity.

name: Laboratory Test
definition: A patient laboratory test record on a date, with blood, liver, kidney, lipid and immunology measurements.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Disease diagnosis text for a patient or examination, such as SLE, RA, APS, SJS, PSS, MCTD or BEHCET.

name: Patient Sex
definition: Sex of a patient: F (female), M (male), or empty for unknown.

name: Thrombosis Severity
definition: Ordinal thrombosis code on an examination, 0-3, where 0 means no thrombosis and higher values indicate increasing severity.

name: Uric Acid
definition: Blood uric acid concentration (UA) with sex-specific normal thresholds.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit percentage (HCT), an indicator of red blood cell proportion.

name: Prothrombin Time
definition: Prothrombin time (PT) blood clotting measurement.

name: LDH
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) enzyme level.

name: Immunoglobulin A
definition: Immunoglobulin A (IGA) level.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol (T-CHO) level in the laboratory record.

name: Patient Age
definition: Age of a patient derived from Birthday; no age column is stored.

name: Patient Admission Type
definition: Admission classification of a patient: '-' (outpatient), '+' (inpatient), '+(' variant, or empty.

name: Anti-SM Antibody
definition: Anti-SM antibody result coded in Laboratory.SM: 'negative' corresponds to '-', '0' to '+-', '1' to '+', and higher numeric values to stronger positivity.

name: Examination Date
definition: Date on which a patient examination took place.

name: Laboratory Test Date
definition: Date on which a laboratory test was performed.

name: Patient First Visit Date
definition: First hospital visit date recorded for a patient (First Date).

name: Patient Visit Date
definition: A patient's recorded visit/description date in the Patient table.

name: Molecule
definition: A molecule identified by molecule_id (for example TR060), labelled as carcinogenic or not.

name: Atom
definition: An atom in a molecule, identified by atom_id of the form <molecule_id>_<atom ordinal>, with element symbol.

name: Chemical Bond
definition: A bond between two atoms of a molecule, identified by bond_id, with a bond type.

name: Bond Type
definition: Chemical bond order: '-' single, '=' double, '#' triple; one row has a null bond type.

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: Molecule carcinogenicity label: '+' means carcinogenic, '-' means non-carcinogenic.

name: Connected Atom Relation
definition: Symmetric connectivity record linking two atoms through a bond; each bond appears in both directions.

name: Chemical Element
definition: Element symbol of an atom in lower-case form, such as c, h, o, n, cl, s, br, na, p.
